simple.meaning: רוֹמָם (rôwmâm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “exaltation , i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 66:17. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.

simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
